# --- [CELL 0]: ---

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras import layers
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

# --- [CELL 5]: ---

train_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='training',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 6]: ---

val_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='validation',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 8]: ---

from tensorflow import keras
data_augmentation = keras.Sequential(
  [
    layers.RandomFlip("horizontal",
                      input_shape=(image_height,
                                  image_width,
                                  3)),
    layers.RandomRotation(0.1),
    layers.RandomZoom(0.1),
  ]
)

# --- [CELL 10]: ---

model = Sequential([
  data_augmentation,
  normalization_layer,
  layers.Conv2D(16, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Dropout(0.2),
  layers.Flatten(),
  layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
  layers.Dense(num_of_classes, name="outputs")
])

# --- [CELL 0]: ---

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd
import tensorflow as tf
from tensorflow.keras.models import Sequential
from tensorflow.keras import layers
from matplotlib import pyplot as plt

# --- [CELL 1]: ---

import pathlib
data_dir = 'data/web_scraped_small'
data_dir = pathlib.Path(data_dir).with_suffix('')

# --- [CELL 2]: ---

image_count = len(list(data_dir.glob('*/*.jpg')))
image_count

# --- [CELL 3]: ---

import PIL
princess = list(data_dir.glob('princess/*'))
PIL.Image.open(str(princess[1]))

# --- [CELL 4]: ---

image_height, image_width = PIL.Image.open(str(princess[1])).size
batch_size,epochs = 64,10

# --- [CELL 5]: ---

train_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='training',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 6]: ---

val_ds = tf.keras.utils.image_dataset_from_directory(
    data_dir,
    validation_split=0.2,
    subset='validation',
    image_size=(image_height, image_width),
    seed = 1,
    shuffle=True,
    batch_size=batch_size
)

# --- [CELL 7]: ---

normalization_layer = layers.Rescaling(1./255)

# --- [CELL 8]: ---

from tensorflow import keras
data_augmentation = keras.Sequential(
  [
    layers.RandomFlip("horizontal",
                      input_shape=(image_height,
                                  image_width,
                                  3)),
    layers.RandomRotation(0.1),
    layers.RandomZoom(0.1),
  ]
)

# --- [CELL 9]: ---

num_of_classes = len(train_ds.class_names)
num_of_classes

# --- [CELL 10]: ---

model = Sequential([
  data_augmentation,
  normalization_layer,
  layers.Conv2D(16, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(32, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Conv2D(64, 3, padding='same', activation='relu'),
  layers.MaxPooling2D(),
  layers.Dropout(0.2),
  layers.Flatten(),
  layers.Dense(128, activation='relu'),
  layers.Dense(num_of_classes, name="outputs")
])

# --- [CELL 11]: ---

model.compile(optimizer='adam', loss=tf.keras.losses.SparseCategoricalCrossentropy(from_logits=True), metrics=['accuracy'])

# --- [CELL 12]: ---

history = model.fit(train_ds,validation_data=val_ds, epochs=1)
